description: Read one person's public door on three.ws: the price of a single message to them, which chains they take it on, how long the message may be, what they say they want to hear about, and the exact endpoint to use. Costs nothing and needs no credential. ALWAYS call this before knock_send on a priced door: the owner can change their price at any time, and the quote you show a human before they approve a payment must be the live one. Read-only.

handle.description: The recipient's three.ws username, with or without the @.

name: knock_quote
title: Quote a door
